metadata.title: What Is a Knowledge Cutoff?
metadata.reformat: full-length; native portrait graphics; preserve source framing

short_validation.note: B01/B02/B04/B06/B11 authored as native portrait Manim scenes in vertical/scenes.py

beats.narration_text: Hi — Bella, in for Gomathy. Ask Claude about last week — it may not know. Here's why.

show.event: composer sits empty, spark idle
the ask types itself into the composer
send arms
three output lines land — the ask lands answered

props.command: What is a knowledge cutoff, and why might Claude miss recent news?
output: Claude learned from text up to a date.
That date is its knowledge cutoff.
After it, you supply the facts.

qc.sparse_reason: Hesitant-writer beat: two short typed lines on a mostly-cream page (house exemption named in final_frame_check.py's sparse_by_design_beats() docstring).

beats.narration_text: Claude doesn't know everything up to today — only what it learned before its cutoff.

show.event: 'Claude knows' / 'everything up to today.' types in on two lines
'everything up to today.' dims and backspaces out
'what it learned before its cutoff.' types in its place

beats.portrait_note: native portrait Manim restack of the landscape scene (vertical/scenes.py); same text and sequence, ink only, labels >= size 32

beats.narration_text: Training is a snapshot. Text up to one date goes in. Nothing after.

show.event: timeline with a dashed 'cutoff' line; 'Training' box
document chips before the line flow into the box
chips after the line arrive, stop at the cutoff, and stay out

beats.portrait_note: native portrait Manim restack of the landscape scene (vertical/scenes.py); same text and sequence, ink only, labels >= size 32

qc.sparse_reason: FormBCard's card grid for 2-3 short items doesn't reach 55% fill by design (same characteristic as the passing FormBCard beats in claude-liam-context-window).

beats.narration_text: Anthropic lists two dates: where knowledge is most reliable, and the broader training range.

show.event: title 'Two dates per model' settles
items reveal in order: Reliable knowledge cutoff, Training data cutoff

beats.narration_text: Between those dates, knowledge thins. Past the training cutoff, the model saw nothing.

show.event: band along a timeline; ILLUSTRATIVE label
solid ink zone 'Most reliable' up to 'Reliable cutoff'
lighter zone 'Thins' up to 'Training cutoff' on 'between those dates'
empty zone 'Nothing seen' past the training cutoff

beats.portrait_note: native portrait Manim restack of the landscape scene (vertical/scenes.py); same text and sequence, ink only, labels >= size 32

qc.sparse_reason: FormBCard's card grid for 2-3 short items doesn't reach 55% fill by design (same characteristic as the passing FormBCard beats in claude-liam-context-window).

beats.narration_text: That gap holds recent news, current prices, and facts that changed.

show.event: title 'After the cutoff' settles
items reveal in order: Recent news, Current prices, Changed facts

beats.narration_text: Ask about something that changed, and you may get the old answer.

show.event: question card 'Latest version of the tool?'; ILLUSTRATIVE label
left: 'Claude's snapshot: v2'
right: 'Today: v3'
'≠' between them marks the mismatch

qc.sparse_reason: FormBCard's card grid for 2-3 short items doesn't reach 55% fill by design (same characteristic as the passing FormBCard beats in claude-liam-context-window).

beats.narration_text: Two fixes: paste in a current source, or use web search for cited, live results.

show.event: title 'Close the gap' settles
items reveal in order: Paste a source, Web search

qc.sparse_reason: FormBCard's card grid for 2-3 short items doesn't reach 55% fill by design (same characteristic as the passing FormBCard beats in claude-liam-context-window).

beats.narration_text: Stable facts? The cutoff matters less. Anything recent? Bring a source.

show.event: title 'Check first' settles
items reveal in order: Stable topics, Recent

qc.sparse_reason: FormBCard's card grid for 2-3 short items doesn't reach 55% fill by design (same characteristic as the passing FormBCard beats in claude-liam-context-window).

beats.narration_text: Summary: Claude's knowledge stops at a date. For anything newer, bring the source.

show.event: title 'Summary' settles
items reveal in order: Stops at a date, Newer? Bring a source

beats.narration_text: Your turn. Paste this: what's your knowledge cutoff, and what in my field might have changed since then? Check: does it say where to verify?

show.event: greeting reads 'Your turn.'
the suggested prompt types into the composer
send arms
